title: EduTutor Golden Set Case
description: One evaluation case in eval/golden_set.jsonl / eval/golden_set_regression.jsonl. One JSON object per line (JSONL).

id.description: Unique case id, prefixed by category, e.g. EDU-QA-001, EDU-GRD-014, EDU-ABS-009.

subcategory.description: Specific sub-case within the category, e.g. 'duplicate_upload_versioning', 'ambiguous_cross_document'.

feature.description: The backend endpoint or function under test, e.g. 'POST /chat/ask'.

input.description: The question/request/action being tested. A plain string for single-turn cases, or an array of {question, expected_behavior} turn objects for multi-turn conversational cases (category=conversational).

context.description: Setup/precondition state needed for the case (e.g. prior attempts, course scope, conversation history).

required_documents.description: document_id values from eval/corpus/ that must be in scope for this case.

required_facts.description: fact_id values from eval/fact_inventory.json that ground this case's expected content. Empty for purely behavioral (non-document) cases.

expected_behavior.description: Specific, testable assertions the system must satisfy.

expected_answer.description: Reference answer for positive grounded cases; null for abstention/behavioral cases.

acceptable_answers.description: Alternate phrasings that would also count as correct (semantic assertions, not brittle exact-match).

must_contain.description: Exact substrings the response must contain, when the system contract specifies an exact message (e.g. a fixed Vietnamese error string).

must_not_contain.description: Substrings that must NOT appear (e.g. stack traces, hallucinated content, off-topic-document facts).

abstention_type.description: Canonical values for the 4 core RAG failure modes: insufficient_evidence, unsupported_claim, needs_clarification, out_of_scope. Feature-specific rejection reasons use their own descriptive value (e.g. needs_entities for Compare, needs_topic for Summarize, blocked_academic_integrity / blocked_injection for Guardrail) — these are intentionally distinct from the 4 core RAG values, not a violation of the 4-value contract.

subquestions.description: Only populated for category=decomposition — the individual sub-questions a compound query breaks into.

expected_coverage.description: For decomposition cases: fraction of subquestions that must be addressed for the case to pass (1.0 = all).

failure_mode.description: What real regression/bug this case is designed to catch.

source_trace.description: Traceability to ground truth: real fact_id(s) from fact_inventory.json for factual cases, or the exact feature_inventory.md row for behavioral cases.
